name: chebwin
comment: Sig: w = chebwin(N[, at]). Dolph-Chebyshev window with `at` dB sidelobe attenuation (default 100). Bug fix 2026-05-08: previous FFT-based impl returned all-ones for even N and a wrongly-shifted window for odd N. Rewrote as direct cosine-IDFT (O(N²)) with cosine basis centered on (N-1)/2. Coverage: N ∈ {1, 7, 8, 16, 64} × R ∈ {30, 60, 100, 120}.
